rows.text: • Earnings per share is expected to be in the range of $42.06 to $42.91 per share based upon weighted average shares outstanding of 56.7 million shares, compared with $35.51 per share in fiscal 2026, which is an increase of 20% at the midpoint;

• Adjusted earnings per share is expected to be in the range of $47.09 to $47.94 per share compared with $41.35 per share in fiscal 2026, an increase of 15% at the midpoint compared to prior year; and
